basics.name: Cameron Green
basics.summary:
Front-end software engineer building customer-facing applications and the tools that support them. My work spans React, Next.js, TypeScript, content platforms, and enterprise integrations at Waste Management and JPMorgan Chase.

At Waste Management, my 2026 work centers on the new wm.com platform: Sanity authoring, Algolia content synchronization, chatbot integration, and customer self-service journeys. Previously, I built Microsoft Office productivity tools and content management systems for 30,000+ banking professionals at JPMorgan Chase.

Outside work, I build web and mobile applications and maintain a homelab for self-hosting, automation, and hands-on learning.

schools.description: Acquired skills for teamwork and created small projects for classes.
Developed my passion for Computer Science, I learned the basics of programming and algorithm usage.

homelab.summary: Maintaining a distributed home lab infrastructure for 5+ years, running containerized services and self-hosted applications across multiple devices. Focused on privacy, automation, performance optimization, and continuous learning through hands-on experimentation with emerging technologies.
